introduction.en: The Economic Survey serves as the annual health check of the Indian economy, providing a comprehensive analysis of industrial performance and policy efficacy.
introduction.hi: The Economic Survey serves as the annual health check of the Indian economy, providing a comprehensive analysis of industrial performance and policy efficacy.

body.en: It identifies key challenges such as logistics costs, regulatory hurdles, and supply chain vulnerabilities. By providing data-backed insights, it guides the government in formulating targeted interventions like the PLI schemes and Gati Shakti, which aim to boost manufacturing and infrastructure.

conclusion.en: Ultimately, the Survey acts as a bridge between economic theory and practical policy, ensuring that industrial growth remains inclusive and sustainable.
